gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ¬ Nat.Prime k → w k = 0) → 0 < Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p)) → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n

plain_statement.zh: 对任意自然数 n，若实权 w 在所有非素数处为零，且 w 在 n 处的加法自卷积严格为正，则 n 可写成两个素数之和。
plain_statement.en: For every natural n, if a real weight w vanishes on every nonprime and its additive self-convolution at n is positive, n is a sum of two primes.

brief.zh: 解析权重估计通向素数对存在性的接口。无需假设 w 非负。
brief.en: Extract a witness from a positive coefficient. The weight may change sign on primes.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; 0 < Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p)) ↔ (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 令素数 p 的权为 log p，非素数的权为零。对任意自然数 n，此权的加法自卷积在 n 处为正，当且仅当 n 是两个素数之和。
plain_statement.en: Give each prime p weight log p and all nonprimes weight zero. At every natural n, the additive self-convolution is positive exactly when n is a sum of two primes.

brief.zh: 素数至少为 2，故其权严格为正。这个等价式固定后续所有逐点下界的含义。
brief.en: Every prime weight is strictly positive. This equivalence fixes the interpretation of the weighted target.

gaps.statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let D : ℝ := Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt p * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n - p)) - Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p)); 0 ≤ D ∧ D ≤ C * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * (Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ 3

plain_statement.zh: 存在绝对常数 C>0，使每个自然数 n≥2 上，冯·芒戈尔特自卷积减去仅取素数对数权的自卷积，介于 0 与 C√n(log n)³ 之间。
plain_statement.en: There is an absolute C > 0 such that for every natural n ≥ 2, subtracting the prime-only logarithmic convolution from the von Mangoldt convolution leaves a value in [0,C√n(log n)³].

brief.zh: 只有至少含一个真素数幂的配对需要扣除。按指数 k≥2 界定可能的素数幂个数，再控制单项权重。
brief.en: Only pairs containing a proper prime power contribute. Bound the number of possible powers and the weight of each pair; see the discussion around (4.19).

gaps.statement: RiemannHypothesis → ∀ (Z : Finset ℂ) (a : ℂ → ℂ) (x : ℝ), 0 < x → (∀ s ∈ Z, 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ riemannZeta s = 0) → ‖Finset.sum Z (fun s => a s * (x : ℂ) ^ s)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt x * Finset.sum Z (fun s => ‖a s‖)

plain_statement.zh: 假设 ζ 的黎曼猜想。对任意正实数 x、任意位于临界带内的有限 ζ 零点集 Z 及复系数 a，加权和 Σ a(s)xˢ 的模不超过 √x Σ|a(s)|。
plain_statement.en: Assume RH for ζ. For any positive real x, any finite set Z of ζ zeros in the open critical strip, and any complex coefficients a, the modulus of Σ a(s)xˢ is at most √x Σ|a(s)|.

brief.zh: 把零点实部固定为 1/2 后使用三角不等式。这只控制已指定的有限零点和，完整显式公式还需要尾项界。
brief.en: Apply RH to each nontrivial zero before the triangle inequality. This controls a specified finite sum; an explicit formula still needs its tail bound.

gaps.statement: (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ q a X : ℕ, 0 < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 2 ≤ X → |(Finset.sum ((Finset.range (X + 1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q)) (fun k => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)) - (X : ℝ) / (Nat.totient q : ℝ)| ≤ C * Real.sqrt (X : ℝ) * (Real.log (2 * (q : ℝ) * (X : ℝ))) ^ 2

plain_statement.zh: 假设所有正模数的狄利克雷 L 函数在临界带中的零点实部均为 1/2。证明存在统一 C>0，使对所有 q≥1、与 q 互素的剩余类 a 和整数 X≥2，该类中截至 X 的冯·芒戈尔特权重和与 X/φ(q) 的差的绝对值至多为 C√X log²(2qX)。
plain_statement.en: Assuming every Dirichlet L-function zero in the open critical strip has real part 1/2, prove a uniform C > 0 bounds the absolute discrepancy of ψ(X;q,a) from X/φ(q) by C√X log²(2qX) for all q ≥ 1, reduced residues a and integers X ≥ 2.

brief.zh: 独立形式化目标。复核原始特征的显式公式、非原始特征的修正及统一常数适用范围，将小模数另行纳入同一估计。
brief.en: Formalize the explicit formula for primitive characters, correction for imprimitive characters and the uniform ranges, including the small moduli. The zero-line premise alone does not supply these estimates.

gaps.statement: RiemannHypothesis → ∀ x : ℝ, 1100000000000000000 ≤ x → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Odd p ∧ Odd q ∧ x < ((p + q : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ ((p + q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x + 123 * (Real.log x) ^ 2

plain_statement.zh: 假设 ζ 的黎曼猜想。对每个实数 x≥1.1×10¹⁸，区间 (x,x+123(log x)²] 内存在一个由两个奇素数相加所得的数。
plain_statement.en: Under RH for ζ, for every real x ≥ 1.1 × 10¹⁸ the interval (x,x+123(log x)²] contains a sum of two odd primes.

brief.zh: 复现 Chirre–Hagen 第 5 节的大参数解析分支。作者使用显式短区间二阶矩估计；结论的存在量词落在区间内部。
brief.en: Reproduce the large-parameter analytic branch of Chirre–Hagen, section 5, using explicit second-moment estimates. The two primes may vary with the interval.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ), let phase : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun k => (w k : ℂ) * phase ((k : ℝ) * t)); let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (S t) ^ 2 * phase (-(n : ℝ) * t); intervalIntegral f (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume = ((Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p)) : ℝ) : ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 给定 n 与任意实权 w。把截至 n 的权构成的三角多项式平方，乘上第 −n 个相位并在 [0,1] 积分，所得正是 w 在 n 处的加法自卷积。
plain_statement.en: For any natural n and real weights w, square the trigonometric polynomial of weights through n, multiply by the negative nth phase, and integrate over [0,1]. The resulting coefficient equals the additive self-convolution at n.

brief.zh: 展开有限双和，使用整数频率在单位区间上的正交性。这一步冻结圆法使用的相位符号和频率。
brief.en: Expand the double sum and apply orthogonality of integral frequencies on the unit interval. This pins the sign and normalization used by the arc estimates.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous u → let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let phase : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun k => (w k : ℂ) * phase ((k : ℝ) * t)); let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (S t) ^ 2 * phase (-(n : ℝ) * t); let A : ℂ := intervalIntegral (fun t => ((u t : ℝ) : ℂ) * f t) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let B : ℂ := intervalIntegral (fun t => (((1 - u t : ℝ) : ℂ)) * f t) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ‖B‖ < A.re → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n

plain_statement.zh: 在频率区间 [0,1] 上，以任何连续实函数 u 和 1−u 分割仅取素数对数权的二元傅里叶系数，记两个积分为 A、B。若 A 的实部严格大于 B 的模，则 n 可表示为两个素数之和。
plain_statement.en: Split the prime-logarithmic binary Fourier coefficient on [0,1] using any continuous real weight u and its complement 1−u. If the real part of the first integral A exceeds the modulus of the second B, n is a sum of two primes.

brief.zh: 这是带前提的归约。适用于平滑主弧截断；控制真正的次弧误差和保证严格余量仍是单独的解析问题。
brief.en: This conditional reduction can use a smooth major-arc cutoff. A usable cutoff and bounds proving a strict margin remain separate analytic inputs.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; 0 < Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p))

plain_statement.zh: 对每一个不小于 4 的偶数 n，证明仅取素数对数权的二元加法卷积在 n 处严格为正。
plain_statement.en: Prove the prime-only logarithmic additive convolution is strictly positive at every even n ≥ 4.

brief.zh: 开放终点，等价于强哥德巴赫猜想。主弧与次弧分割、筛法或新的相关估计均可尝试。逐点严格正性是尚缺的输入。
brief.en: Open endpoint equivalent to strong Goldbach. A major/minor-arc argument, a sieve, or a new correlation estimate would have to deliver strict positivity at each input.

gaps.statement: ∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < c ∧ ∀ X n : ℕ, N ≤ X → X ≤ n → n < 2 * X → Even n → let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; c * (n : ℝ) ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p))

plain_statement.zh: 寻找 c>0 和自然数 N，使每个 X≥N 的二倍区间 [X,2X) 内，每个偶数 n 的素数对数权二元卷积至少为 cn。
plain_statement.en: Find c > 0 and a natural N such that the prime-logarithmic binary convolution is at least cn for every even n in every dyadic interval [X,2X) with X ≥ N.

brief.zh: 开放的逐点定量下界，比最终仅要求正性更强。分母中的可能例外与次弧的负贡献都需统一控制，隐式门槛还需有效化。
brief.en: Open quantitative strengthening of eventual positivity. Uniform control of the negative minor-arc contribution and effective thresholds would be needed to connect this approach to the endpoint.

gaps.statement: (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2) → let E : ℕ → ℕ := fun X => ((Finset.range (X + 1)).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ n % 2 = 0 ∧ ((Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n - p))).card = 0)).card; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ (C : ℝ) (X₀ : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → (E X : ℝ) ≤ C * (X : ℝ) ^ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) + ε)

plain_statement.zh: 假设所有狄利克雷 L 函数的临界带零点实部均为 1/2。记 E(X) 为 [4,X] 中没有两素数表示的偶数个数。对每个 ε>0，证明存在 C>0 和 X₀，使 X≥X₀ 时 E(X)≤C X^(1/2+ε)。
plain_statement.en: Assume the zero-line statement in the critical strip for all Dirichlet L-functions. For each ε > 0 prove that E(X), the number of even exceptions from 4 through X, is at most C X^(1/2+ε) for some C > 0 and all X beyond some X₀.

brief.zh: 审查并复现 Pintz–Althöfer 预印本在 θ=1/2 的条件推论。卡点是把特征族估计传到例外集，不可用有限验证代替。
brief.en: Audit and reproduce the preprint's conditional consequence at θ = 1/2, tracking the character-family estimates and their transfer to the exception count.

gaps.statement: ∃ s : ℕ → Bool, (∀ n : ℕ, s n = true → 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n) ∧ (∀ M : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, M < n ∧ s n = true) ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, ((Finset.range (X + 1)).filter (fun n => s n = true)).card ≤ Nat.sqrt X + 1

plain_statement.zh: 构造一个自然数的可判定子集，其元素均为至少 4 的偶数，任意阈值之后仍有元素，但截至每个 X 的元素数至多为 ⌊√X⌋+1。
plain_statement.en: Construct a decidable subset of even integers at least 4 with an element beyond every threshold, yet with at most floor(√X)+1 elements through every X.

brief.zh: 可尝试两倍平方数集合。这个抽象例子解释为什么平方根数量级的例外上界仍不足以证明逐点无例外。
brief.en: Try twice-squares. This abstract obstruction isolates the logical gap between a square-root exceptional-set bound and pointwise coverage.

gaps.statement: ∀ (I F : Finset ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (B : ℝ), F ⊆ I → 0 < B → (∀ n ∈ F, B ≤ |e n|) → (F.card : ℝ) * B ^ 2 ≤ Finset.sum I (fun n => |e n| ^ 2)

plain_statement.zh: 设 F⊆I 为有限自然数集合、e 为实值函数且 B>0。若 F 中每个 n 均满足 |e(n)|≥B，则 |F|·B² 不超过 I 上的误差平方和。
plain_statement.en: Let F ⊆ I be finite sets of natural numbers, e a real-valued function, and B > 0. If |e(n)| ≥ B for every n in F, then the cardinality of F times B² is at most the sum of squared errors over I.

brief.zh: 先在 F 上逐项比较，再利用平方项非负把求和范围扩大到 I。
brief.en: First compare summands on F, then use nonnegativity of squares to enlarge the sum to I.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ), 2 * (Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p))) = 2 * Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => (w p) ^ 2) - Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => (w p - w (n - p)) ^ 2)

plain_statement.zh: 对任意实权 w 与自然数 n，n 处加法自卷积的两倍，等于 [0,n] 上权平方和的两倍减去 w 与反射权 p↦w(n−p) 的平方差之和。
plain_statement.en: For any real weight w and natural n, twice its additive self-convolution at n equals twice the sum of its squares on [0,n], minus the sum of squared differences between w and its reflection p ↦ w(n−p).

brief.zh: 本项目提出的替代归约。用反射置换和极化恒等式把双素数相关转成平方差；下一步仍需控制真正素数权的平方差。
brief.en: Project-proposed reduction via the reflection permutation and polarization. Pointwise estimates on the reflected differences of actual prime weights remain open.

gaps.statement: ∀ (I W : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (B : ℝ), W ⊆ I → 0 < B → (∀ m ∈ W, |e n - e m| ≤ B / 2) → Finset.sum I (fun m => (e m) ^ 2) < (W.card : ℝ) * (B / 2) ^ 2 → |e n| < B

plain_statement.zh: 设 W⊆I 是自然数的有限集合，B>0。若 W 中每点的实误差与目标 n 的误差相差至多 B/2，且 I 上的误差平方和严格小于 |W|(B/2)²，则 n 的误差绝对值小于 B。
plain_statement.en: Let W ⊆ I be finite sets of natural numbers and B > 0. If every m in W has error differing from the error at n by at most B/2, and the total squared error on I is less than |W|(B/2)², then |e(n)| < B.

brief.zh: 本项目的局部归约。若误差大，整片 W 都必须付出能量。要应用于真实的二元卷积，须独立证明局部振荡和均方预算。
brief.en: Project-proposed localization: a large error at n must cost energy throughout W. Applying it to binary prime correlation still requires oscillation and second-moment bounds.

gaps.statement: ∀ n p : ℕ, let reps := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p)); p ∈ reps n → n-p ∈ reps n

plain_statement.zh: 交换两个加数给出表示集的自映射。

brief.zh: 先由成员资格推出 p≤n。
brief.en: Recover p≤n before simplifying subtraction.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, let reps := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p)); (reps n).card = 2*((reps n).filter (fun p => 2*p<n)).card + (if Even n ∧ Nat.Prime (n/2) then 1 else 0)

plain_statement.zh: 由严格下半部和对角项还原有序表示数。
plain_statement.en: Recover ordered counts from the lower half and diagonal.

brief.zh: 用反射配对非对角项。
brief.en: Pair off-diagonal terms by reflection.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, Even n → 4<n → let reps := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p)); ∀ p ∈ reps n, Odd p ∧ Odd (n-p)

plain_statement.zh: 大于四的偶数的每个素数表示都由两个奇素数组成。
plain_statement.en: Every representation of an even number above four uses two odd primes.

brief.zh: 单列素数 2 的可能性。
brief.en: Isolate the prime two.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, let reps := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p)); ∀ p ∈ reps n, ¬ Nat.Coprime p n → n=2*p

plain_statement.zh: 与目标数有公因子的表示只能是对角表示。
plain_statement.en: A noncoprime prime summand forces a diagonal representation.

brief.zh: 公因子必须等于 p，也整除另一个素数。
brief.en: The common prime divides both summands.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, let reps := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p)); (reps n).card ≤ ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter Nat.Prime).card

plain_statement.zh: 有序表示数至多为不超过 n 的素数个数。
plain_statement.en: The prime count bounds the ordered representation count.

brief.zh: 比较两组过滤条件。
brief.en: Include the representation set in the primes up to n.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 2≤n → let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let reps := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p)); let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); (reps n).card*(Real.log 2)^2 ≤ conv w w n ∧ conv w w n ≤ (reps n).card*(Real.log (n:ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 用有序表示数从两侧控制对数加权卷积。
plain_statement.en: Sandwich the log-weighted correlation using the ordered count.

brief.zh: 在表示集上逐项夹逼。
brief.en: Bound each surviving prime weight above and below.

gaps.statement: let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); ∀ (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), conv u v n = conv v u n

plain_statement.zh: 有限加法卷积交换两个权函数后不变。

brief.zh: 反向重排长度 n+1 的和。
brief.en: Reverse the summation order.

gaps.statement: let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); ∀ (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ), Finset.sum (Finset.range (N+1)) (conv u v) = Finset.sum (Finset.range (N+1)) (fun p => u p * Finset.sum (Finset.range (N-p+1)) v)

plain_statement.zh: 前缀卷积总量等于三角形区域上的双和。
plain_statement.en: Total prefix correlation equals a triangular double sum.

brief.zh: 按第一个加数重新分组。
brief.en: Group the lattice triangle by the first summand.

gaps.statement: let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); ∀ (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ), (∀ k, 0≤u k ∧ 0≤v k) → let T := Finset.range (n+1); conv u v n - Finset.sum (T ∩ A) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)) = Finset.sum (T \ A) (fun k => u k*v (n-k))

plain_statement.zh: 截取加数窗口时，损失恰等于窗口外的卷积质量。
plain_statement.en: The loss from a summand window equals the mass outside it.

brief.zh: 把完整区间分成两个不交部分。
brief.en: Partition the summation range into disjoint pieces.

gaps.statement: let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); ∀ (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), (conv u v n)^2 ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun p => (u p)^2) * Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun p => (v p)^2)

plain_statement.zh: 用两个权的平方和控制卷积系数的平方。
plain_statement.en: Bound a squared correlation by the product of two energies.

brief.zh: 对反射后的第二组权用柯西不等式。
brief.en: Apply Cauchy–Schwarz with the reflected second weight.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let h := fun k : ℕ => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k-w k; ∀ k, 0 ≤ h k

plain_statement.zh: Λ 减去素数对数权逐点非负。
plain_statement.en: The residual Mangoldt weight is nonnegative.

brief.zh: 将素数与合数分开讨论。
brief.en: Separate primes from composite indices.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let h := fun k : ℕ => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k-w k; ∀ k, h k ≠ 0 → ∃ p j : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2≤j ∧ k=p^j

brief.zh: 将候选数放进幂映射的有限像。

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let h := fun k : ℕ => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k-w k; ∀ X k : ℕ, 2≤X → k≤X → h k ≤ Real.log (X:ℝ)

brief.en: Use logarithmic growth versus a fixed positive power.

plain_statement.en: Admissible first residues are periodic in the target.

brief.en: Use invariance of gcd under adding q.

gaps.statement: let U := fun q n : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+q-a) q); ∀ q n a, a ∈ U q n → (n+q-a)%q ∈ U q n

brief.zh: 利用 a<q 后再化简自然数减法。
brief.en: Use a<q before simplifying the natural subtraction.

plain_statement.zh: 精确计算模二时可用的单位余类数。
plain_statement.en: Determine the mod-two admissible residue count.

brief.zh: 唯一可逆类是 1，检查反射后的剩余类。
brief.en: The only unit is one. Inspect its reflection.

gaps.statement: let U := fun q n : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+q-a) q); ∀ p n a, Nat.Prime p → a

plain_statement.zh: 素模数下只需排除 0 和目标数的余类。
plain_statement.en: At a prime modulus only zero and the target residue are forbidden.

brief.zh: 将与素数互素改写成非整除。
brief.en: Replace coprimality to a prime by nondivisibility.

gaps.statement: let U := fun q n : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+q-a) q); ∀ p n, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n → (U p n).card=p-1

plain_statement.zh: 局部素数整除目标时恰有 p−1 个允许类。
plain_statement.en: A prime dividing the target leaves p−1 admissible residues.

brief.zh: 两个禁类重合。
brief.en: Identify the two forbidden classes.

gaps.statement: let U := fun q n : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+q-a) q); ∀ p n, Nat.Prime p → ¬ p ∣ n → (U p n).card=p-2

plain_statement.zh: 局部素数不整除目标时恰有 p−2 个允许类。
plain_statement.en: A prime away from the target leaves p−2 admissible residues.

brief.zh: 证明两个禁类互异。
brief.en: Show the two removed classes are distinct.

gaps.statement: let U := fun q n : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+q-a) q); ∀ p k n, Nat.Prime p → (U (p^(k+1)) n).card=p^k*(U p n).card

plain_statement.zh: 模素数的允许类提升到素数幂时各有相同的提升数。
plain_statement.en: Each admissible residue lifts pᵏ times modulo pᵏ⁺¹.

brief.zh: 按模 p 投影分纤维。
brief.en: Group residues by their image modulo p.

gaps.statement: let U := fun q n : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+q-a) q); ∀ q r n, 0<q → 0<r → Nat.Coprime q r → (U (q*r) n).card=(U q n).card*(U r n).card

plain_statement.zh: 互素模数上的允许类数由中国剩余定理相乘。
plain_statement.en: Admissible counts multiply over coprime moduli.

brief.zh: 同时追踪首加数和被反射的另一项的可逆性。
brief.en: Track both unit conditions through the CRT bijection.

gaps.statement: let U := fun q n : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+q-a) q); ∀ q n, 0<q → Even n → (U q n).Nonempty

plain_statement.zh: 偶数目标在每个正模数下都有一对可逆余类。
plain_statement.en: Every even target passes the unit-pair test at every positive modulus.

brief.zh: 先处理素数幂再组合。
brief.en: Assemble prime powers by CRT.

gaps.statement: let U := fun q n : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ Nat.Coprime (n+q-a) q); ∀ q n T, 0<q → ((Finset.range (q*T)).filter (fun a => a%q ∈ U q n)).card=T*(U q n).card

plain_statement.zh: 完整周期内局部筛的幸存数精确等于周期数乘以允许类数。
plain_statement.en: Count local-sieve survivors over complete periods exactly.

brief.zh: 按商和余数分解候选数。
brief.en: Decompose the interval by quotient and remainder.

plain_statement.zh: 把奇素数的局部计数除以独立模型的密度。
plain_statement.en: Identify the odd-prime correction as the normalized unit-pair count.

brief.zh: 按 p 是否整除 n 分两种情形。
brief.en: Split according to divisibility of n.

plain_statement.zh: 分离整除目标时的局部增益。
plain_statement.en: Factor the extra local boost at primes dividing the target.

brief.zh: 通分前核对 p−2 非零。
brief.en: Clear denominators using p>2.

plain_statement.zh: 每个奇素数因子都不小于一个正的通用基准。
plain_statement.en: Each odd-prime factor dominates a positive baseline.

brief.zh: 分别讨论整除和不整除。
brief.en: Compare the two divisibility cases.

gaps.statement: ∀ m : ℕ, Finset.prod (Finset.range m) (fun j => 1-1/((j:ℝ)+2)^2) = ((m:ℝ)+2)/(2*((m:ℝ)+1))

plain_statement.zh: 连续整数上的对照乘积有显式望远镜公式。
plain_statement.en: Evaluate the integer comparison product by telescoping.

brief.zh: 分解 1−1/k²。
brief.en: Factor each term as (k−1)(k+1)/k².

gaps.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ), A ⊆ Finset.range m → (1/2:ℝ) ≤ Finset.prod A (fun j => 1-1/((j:ℝ)+2)^2)

plain_statement.zh: 整数对照乘积的任意子乘积都至少为 1/2。
plain_statement.en: Every finite subproduct of the integer comparison factors is at least one half.

brief.zh: 补上的每个因子处于零与一之间。
brief.en: Bound omitted factors by one.

gaps.statement: let fac := fun p n : ℕ => if p ∣ n then (p:ℝ)/((p:ℝ)-1) else 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2; let P := fun Q : ℕ => (Finset.range (Q+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ 2<p); ∀ Q n, 1 ≤ 2*Finset.prod (P Q) (fun p => fac p n)

plain_statement.zh: 计入模二对偶数的因子 2 后，截断主项乘积统一至少为一。
plain_statement.en: The truncated product with parity factor two has a uniform floor of one.

brief.zh: 把 p−1 送到整数对照乘积的索引。
brief.en: Embed p−1 into the comparison product.

plain_statement.zh: 乘积相对一的亏损至多是各项亏损之和。
plain_statement.en: The loss of a product of unit-interval factors is bounded by the sum of losses.

brief.zh: 逐个加入因子并保留有利的交叉项。
brief.en: Induct over the factors and retain the favorable cross term.

gaps.statement: ∀ a b : ℕ, 2≤a → Finset.sum (Finset.Icc a b) (fun k => 1/(k:ℝ)^2) ≤ 1/((a:ℝ)-1)

plain_statement.en: Bound a finite inverse-square tail explicitly.

brief.zh: 用相邻倒数之差逐项控制。
brief.en: Compare each summand with a telescoping difference.

gaps.statement: let P := fun Q : ℕ => (Finset.range (Q+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ 2<p); ∀ Q R : ℕ, 3≤Q → Q≤R → let T := P R \ P Q; 1-Finset.prod T (fun p => 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2) ≤ 1/((Q:ℝ)-1)

plain_statement.en: The baseline odd-prime tail loses at most 1/(Q−1).

brief.zh: 将 p−1 的倒数平方尾部放大到全体整数。
brief.en: Dominate the shifted prime tail by all integers.

gaps.statement: let fac := fun p n : ℕ => if p ∣ n then (p:ℝ)/((p:ℝ)-1) else 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2; let P := fun Q : ℕ => (Finset.range (Q+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ 2<p); ∀ Q n, Finset.prod (P Q) (fun p => fac p n) = Finset.prod (P Q) (fun p => 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2) * Finset.prod ((P Q).filter (fun p => p ∣ n)) (fun p => ((p:ℝ)-1)/((p:ℝ)-2))

brief.zh: 对整除与不整除的因子分别展开。
brief.en: Split the finite product by divisibility.

brief.en: Use the norm formula for the complex exponential.

plain_statement.en: A phase is invariant under integer translation.

brief.en: Separate the integer multiple of 2πi.

gaps.statement: ∀ (z : ℂ) (m : ℕ), (1-z)*Finset.sum (Finset.range m) (fun j => z^j) = 1-z^m

plain_statement.en: The denominator-free finite geometric identity includes resonance.

brief.zh: 逐项消去相邻幂。
brief.en: Telescope consecutive powers.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let c := fun (M j k : ℕ) => E ((j:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)/(M:ℝ)); ∀ M k, 0<M → (c M 1 k=1 ↔ M ∣ k)

plain_statement.en: The basic additive character resonates exactly at multiples of M.

brief.zh: 将复指数等于一化为整数条件。
brief.en: Translate exponential resonance to integrality.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let c := fun (M j k : ℕ) => E ((j:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)/(M:ℝ)); ∀ M k, 0<M → Finset.sum (Finset.range M) (fun j => c M j k) = if M ∣ k then (M:ℂ) else 0

plain_statement.en: Summing the characters detects divisibility by the modulus.

brief.zh: 共振直接求和，其余用几何和。
brief.en: Separate resonance from the geometric-series case.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let c := fun (M j k : ℕ) => E ((j:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)/(M:ℝ)); let F := fun (M : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range M) (fun k => f k*c M j k); ∀ M f k, k<M → Finset.sum (Finset.range M) (fun j => F M f j * star (c M j k)) = (M:ℂ)*f k

brief.zh: 展开变换并用正交性消掉异频项。
brief.en: Expand the transform and cancel off-diagonal characters.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let c := fun (M j k : ℕ) => E ((j:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)/(M:ℝ)); let F := fun (M : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range M) (fun k => f k*c M j k); ∀ M f, Finset.sum (Finset.range M) (fun j => ‖F M f j‖^2) = (M:ℝ)*Finset.sum (Finset.range M) (fun k => ‖f k‖^2)

brief.en: Expand squared norms and sum over frequency first.

brief.en: Bound the entire sum before reducing modulo the period.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let c := fun (M j k : ℕ) => E ((j:ℝ)*(k:ℝ)/(M:ℝ)); let F := fun (M : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range M) (fun k => f k*c M j k); let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ), let M := 2*n+1; let f := fun k : ℕ => if k≤n then (w k:ℂ) else 0; Finset.sum (Finset.range M) (fun j => (F M f j)^2 * star (c M j n)) = (M:ℂ)*(conv w w n:ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 用 2n+1 个精确的频率样点还原二元卷积。
plain_statement.en: Recover the binary convolution from exactly 2n+1 frequency samples.

brief.zh: 先提取模 M 的和，再用无折叠引理。
brief.en: Extract a modular sum, then remove wraparound.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ m : ℤ, intervalIntegral (fun t => E ((m:ℝ)*t)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume = if m=0 then 1 else 0

plain_statement.zh: 整数频率积分只保留零频。
plain_statement.en: Only the constant integer frequency survives integration.

brief.zh: 对非零频率取显式原函数。
brief.en: Integrate a nonzero harmonic by its antiderivative.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); ∀ n w, Continuous (S n w)

plain_statement.zh: 截断指数和在频率变量上连续。
plain_statement.en: Truncated exponential sums are continuous in frequency.

brief.zh: 使用有限和连续性。
brief.en: Use continuity of each summand.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); ∀ n w t, ‖S n w t‖ ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => |w k|)

plain_statement.en: Bound any frequency by the total absolute coefficient mass.

brief.zh: 使用单位相位和三角不等式。
brief.en: Apply the triangle inequality and unit norm.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); ∀ n w t, S n w (-t) = star (S n w t)

plain_statement.en: For real weights, negating frequency conjugates the sum.

brief.zh: 将共轭分配进有限和。
brief.en: Distribute conjugation across the finite sum.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); ∀ n w s t, ‖S n w s-S n w t‖ ≤ 2*Real.pi*|s-t| * Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (k:ℝ)*|w k|)

plain_statement.zh: 频率微扰造成的误差由权的一阶矩控制。
plain_statement.en: A frequency perturbation is controlled by the first absolute moment.

brief.zh: 先估计单个相位的弦长。
brief.en: Bound the chord length of each harmonic.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); ∀ n w, intervalIntegral (fun t => ‖S n w t‖^2) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume = Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k)^2)

plain_statement.zh: 单位区间上的频谱能量等于系数平方和。
plain_statement.en: Integrated spectral energy equals squared coefficient mass.

brief.zh: 展开平方并用整数频率积分。
brief.en: Expand the square and integrate integer harmonics.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); ∀ n w, let T := Finset.range (n+1); intervalIntegral (fun t => ‖S n w t‖^4) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume = Finset.sum (Finset.range (2*n+1)) (fun s => (Finset.sum (T.filter (fun a => a ≤ s ∧ s-a ≤ n)) (fun a => w a*w (s-a)))^2)

plain_statement.zh: 四次矩等于所有加法和系数的平方和。
plain_statement.en: The fourth moment equals the sum of squared additive coefficients.

brief.zh: 对指数和的平方使用 Parseval，注意支集到 2n。
brief.en: Apply Parseval to the square, whose support extends to 2n.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); ∀ n u v, intervalIntegral (fun t => S n u t*S n v t*E (-(n:ℝ)*t)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume = (conv u v n:ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 提取两个不同权函数的混合卷积系数。
plain_statement.en: Extract mixed coefficients of two different weights.

brief.zh: 频率抵消恰在两个下标之和等于 n 时发生。
brief.en: Match exactly the pairs whose frequencies sum to n.

gaps.statement: ∀ f : ℝ → ℂ, ∀ u : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous f → Continuous u → intervalIntegral (fun t => (u t:ℂ)*f t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume + intervalIntegral (fun t => ((1-u t:ℝ):ℂ)*f t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume = intervalIntegral (fun t => f t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.zh: 连续窗口及其补窗口的积分之和还原完整系数。
plain_statement.en: A continuous mask and its complement reconstruct the full integral.

brief.zh: 先证可积再用积分线性。
brief.en: Establish integrability before using linearity.

gaps.statement: ∀ (z : ℂ) (t : ℝ), (z^2 * Complex.exp ((-(t:ℂ))*Complex.I)).re = (z.re^2-z.im^2)*Real.cos t + 2*z.re*z.im*Real.sin t

plain_statement.zh: 把带负频率的平方指数和的实部展开成两个有符号振荡项。
plain_statement.en: Resolve the real part of a demodulated square into signed sine and cosine terms.

brief.zh: 写出复指数的实部与虚部，核对负频率的符号。
brief.en: Expand the exponential and track the sign of the negative frequency.

gaps.statement: let ap := fun (q a N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range (N+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=a)) f; ∀ q N f, 0<q → Finset.sum (Finset.range q) (fun a => ap q a N f) = Finset.sum (Finset.range (N+1)) f

plain_statement.zh: 所有余类的加权质量之和等于总质量。
plain_statement.en: Residue-class masses partition the full weighted count.

brief.zh: 按 k mod q 分组。
brief.en: Partition by k modulo q.

gaps.statement: let ap := fun (q a N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range (N+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=a)) f; ∀ q d a N f, 0<q → 0<d → a<q → ap q a N f = Finset.sum (Finset.range d) (fun j => ap (q*d) (a+j*q) N f)

plain_statement.zh: 将一个同余类细分到倍数模数。
plain_statement.en: Refine a progression into classes at a multiple modulus.

brief.zh: 用唯一的商余表示列举子类。
brief.en: Index the subclasses using quotient and remainder.

gaps.statement: ∀ q k : ℕ, Nat.Prime k → ¬ Nat.Coprime (k%q) q → k ∣ q

plain_statement.zh: 落在不可逆余类中的素数必整除模数。
plain_statement.en: Prime indices in nonunit residues divide the modulus.

brief.zh: 用 gcd(k mod q,q)=gcd(k,q)。
brief.en: Reduce the claim to gcd(k,q).

gaps.statement: ∀ q k : ℕ, ¬ Nat.Coprime k q → ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k ≠ 0 → ∃ p j : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ q ∧ 0<j ∧ k=p^j

plain_statement.zh: 在不可逆余类中，非零 Λ 项只能来自模数的素因子的幂。
plain_statement.en: Nonzero Mangoldt weights in nonunit classes are powers of primes dividing the modulus.

brief.zh: 先用素数幂支集，再把公因子传到底数。
brief.en: Use prime-power support, then identify its common prime factor.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let ap := fun (q a N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range (N+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=a)) f; let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); ∀ (N q h : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ), 0<q → S N f ((h:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)) = Finset.sum (Finset.range q) (fun a => (ap q a N f:ℂ)*E ((h:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))

plain_statement.zh: 有理频率的和可由模 q 的各余类质量精确恢复。
plain_statement.en: Reconstruct a rational-frequency sum from exact progression masses.

brief.zh: 每个余类内的相位相同。
brief.en: Show phase constancy within each residue class.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (q h : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (M e : ℝ), let U := (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q); (∀ a ∈ U, |f a-M|≤e) → ‖Finset.sum U (fun a => ((f a-M:ℝ):ℂ)*E ((h:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))‖ ≤ (U.card:ℝ)*e

plain_statement.zh: 对可逆余类的均值偏差求相位和时，误差至多按余类数放大。
plain_statement.en: Transport uniform unit-class error to a rational exponential sum.

brief.zh: 在每个余类上应用误差假设。
brief.en: Apply the uniform error before summing absolute values.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A g : ℕ → ℂ), Finset.sum (Finset.range N) (fun k => (A (k+1)-A k)*g k) = A N*g N-A 0*g 0-Finset.sum (Finset.range N) (fun k => A (k+1)*(g (k+1)-g k))

plain_statement.zh: 写出保留两个端点的离散分部求和公式。
plain_statement.en: Prove summation by parts including both endpoints.

brief.zh: 展开乘积的相邻差再求和。
brief.en: Telescope increments of the product.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A g : ℕ → ℂ) (e : ℝ), A 0=0 → (∀ k≤N, ‖A k‖≤e) → ‖Finset.sum (Finset.range N) (fun k => (A (k+1)-A k)*g k)‖ ≤ e*(‖g N‖+Finset.sum (Finset.range N) (fun k => ‖g (k+1)-g k‖))

plain_statement.zh: 前缀误差一致有界时，以窗口的总变差估计加权误差。
plain_statement.en: Use cutoff variation to control a weighted error from a prefix bound.

brief.zh: 使用含端点的分部求和。
brief.en: Use the endpoint-inclusive Abel identity.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (N : ℕ) (b : ℝ), Finset.sum (Finset.range N) (fun k => ‖E (((k:ℝ)+1)*b)-E ((k:ℝ)*b)‖) ≤ 2*Real.pi*(N:ℝ)*|b|

plain_statement.zh: 离有理中心偏移 b 的相位序列，其总变差至多为 2πN|b|。
plain_statement.en: Bound the phase variation at an offset b from an arc center.

brief.zh: 逐段弦长至多为对应弧长。
brief.en: Control each chord by its arc length.

gaps.statement: (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1/2) → let ap := fun (q a N : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range (N+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=a)) f; ∀ e : ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ X q a : ℕ, N≤X → 0<q → q≤Nat.log 2 (X+2) → a<q → Nat.Coprime a q → |ap q a X ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt-(X:ℝ)/(Nat.totient q:ℝ)| ≤ e*(X:ℝ)/(Nat.totient q:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 在 GRH 下，对数范围内模数的所有可逆类具有一致的相对误差衰减。
plain_statement.en: Under GRH obtain vanishing relative error uniformly for moduli up to log₂(X+2).

brief.zh: 从现有 GRH 余类误差命题出发，统一吸收对数因子。
brief.en: Start with the existing GRH progression estimate and absorb logarithmic losses.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let ram := fun (q h : ℕ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)) (fun a => E ((h:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))); ∀ q, 0<q → ram q 0=(Nat.totient q:ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 零频率的单位根和等于欧拉函数。
plain_statement.en: At zero frequency the unit-character sum is Euler’s totient.

brief.zh: 每个单位的贡献为一。
brief.en: Count the unit residues with phase one.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let ram := fun (q h : ℕ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)) (fun a => E ((h:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))); ∀ q h, 0<q → ram q (h+q)=ram q h

plain_statement.zh: 单位根和对频率模 q 周期。
plain_statement.en: Ramanujan sums are periodic in frequency modulo q.

brief.zh: 去掉相位中的整数增量。
brief.en: Remove the integer phase increment.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let ram := fun (q h : ℕ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)) (fun a => E ((h:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))); ∀ p h, Nat.Prime p → ram p h = if p ∣ h then ((p:ℂ)-1) else -1

plain_statement.zh: 素模数的单位根和在共振及非共振时有两个精确值。
plain_statement.en: Evaluate prime-modulus Ramanujan sums at both resonant and nonresonant frequencies.

brief.zh: 从完整特征和中去掉零余类。
brief.en: Remove the zero residue from the full character sum.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let ram := fun (q h : ℕ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)) (fun a => E ((h:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))); ∀ p j h, Nat.Prime p → ram (p^(j+1)) h = (if p^(j+1) ∣ h then ((p^(j+1):ℕ):ℂ) else 0) - (if p^j ∣ h then ((p^j:ℕ):ℂ) else 0)

plain_statement.zh: 素数幂模数的单位根和是两个完整特征和之差。
plain_statement.en: At a prime power the Ramanujan sum is a difference of two full character sums.

brief.zh: 剔除 p 的倍数，再约去相位分母中的 p。
brief.en: Remove multiples of p and reduce the denominator.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let ram := fun (q h : ℕ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)) (fun a => E ((h:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))); ∀ q r h, 0<q → 0<r → Nat.Coprime q r → ram (q*r) h=ram q h*ram r h

plain_statement.zh: 单位根和对互素模数乘法分解。
plain_statement.en: Factor Ramanujan sums over coprime moduli.

brief.zh: 在 CRT 坐标中把可逆缩放吸收到各自的单位求和变量。
brief.en: Absorb the CRT unit multipliers by permuting each unit group.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let ram := fun (q h : ℕ) => Finset.sum ((Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q)) (fun a => E ((h:ℝ)*(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ))); let fac := fun p n : ℕ => if p ∣ n then (p:ℝ)/((p:ℝ)-1) else 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2; ∀ p n, Nat.Prime p → 2

plain_statement.zh: 以素模数的 Ramanujan 和写出单个奇异级数因子。
plain_statement.en: Express an odd local singular factor through a prime Ramanujan sum.

brief.zh: 代入素模数的两种值。
brief.en: Insert the two prime-modulus evaluations.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let K := fun (N : ℕ) (b : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (N+1)) (fun k => E ((k:ℝ)*b)); ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ a : ℤ, K N (a:ℝ) = ((N+1:ℕ):ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 截断几何核在整数频率处达到 N+1。
plain_statement.en: The cutoff geometric kernel has height N+1 at integer frequencies.

brief.zh: 整数相位逐项为一。
brief.en: Evaluate each integer harmonic.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let K := fun (N : ℕ) (b : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (N+1)) (fun k => E ((k:ℝ)*b)); ∀ N b, E b ≠ 1 → ‖K N b‖ ≤ 2/‖1-E b‖

plain_statement.zh: 在非共振频率，以相位到 1 的距离控制几何核。
plain_statement.en: Away from resonance, bound the kernel by twice the inverse chord distance.

brief.zh: 结合几何和与单位圆直径。
brief.en: Combine the geometric sum and unit-circle diameter.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let K := fun (N : ℕ) (b : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (N+1)) (fun k => E ((k:ℝ)*b)); ∀ N s : ℕ, s≤N → intervalIntegral (fun t => (K N t)^2*E (-(s:ℝ)*t)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume = ((s+1:ℕ):ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 几何核平方在支集前半段的第 s 个系数恰为 s+1。
plain_statement.en: In the lower half of its support the squared kernel has coefficient s+1.

brief.zh: 频率对 i+j=s 恰有 s+1 组。
brief.en: Count pairs with i+j=s.

plain_statement.zh: 由指数和的一次近似误差得到其平方的误差。
plain_statement.en: Transfer an exponential-sum approximation to its square.

brief.zh: 因式分解 z²−w²，再以模型和误差控制 z+w。
brief.en: Factor the square difference and bound z+w through the model.

plain_statement.zh: 两个不同有理中心距离至少为分母积的倒数。
plain_statement.en: Distinct rational arc centers are separated by the reciprocal denominator product.

brief.zh: 交叉相乘后的分子是非零整数。
brief.en: Use the nonzero integer cross-difference.

plain_statement.zh: 当 2Q²<n 时，不同中心的两条主弧互不重叠。
plain_statement.en: Distinct major arcs are disjoint once 2Q²<n.

brief.zh: 比较两条半径之和与 Farey 间隔。
brief.en: Compare the sum of the radii with Farey separation.

gaps.statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → 2*(Q n)^2<n

plain_statement.zh: 所选对数截断最终满足主弧不重叠的尺度条件。
plain_statement.en: The selected logarithmic cutoff eventually ensures disjointness.

brief.zh: 用对数的四次方小于任意正比例的 n。
brief.en: Compare log⁴ n with n.

gaps.statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; ∀ n, MeasurableSet (arcs n)

plain_statement.zh: 证明研究路线中实际选用的有理邻域并集可测。
plain_statement.en: Prove measurability of the specified union of rational neighborhoods.

brief.zh: 将存在量词展开为可数个闭区间的并。
brief.en: Express the existential definition as a countable union of closed intervals.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let minor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); ∀ n, major n+minor n=(conv w w n:ℂ)

plain_statement.zh: 在同一截断下，两个弧积分之和精确等于目标素数卷积。
plain_statement.en: The two arc integrals add to the target prime correlation.

brief.zh: 用可测性分割积分，再提取第 n 个系数。
brief.en: Split the measurable integrand and extract the nth coefficient.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0<c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → c*(n:ℝ) ≤ (major n).re

plain_statement.zh: 研究目标：证明这组主弧的实贡献对所有充分大偶数有统一的正线性下界。
plain_statement.en: Research target: a uniform positive linear floor on these major arcs for all sufficiently large evens.

brief.zh: 从有理中心模型、局部乘积下界和积分误差预算出发；须对 n 一致。
brief.en: Combine the rational model, singular factors and integrated errors uniformly in n.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let minor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e : ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ)) ≤ (minor n).re

plain_statement.zh: 研究目标：对任意 ε>0，这组次弧的带符号实贡献对所有充分大偶数都至少为 −εn。
plain_statement.en: Research target: for every ε>0 the signed minor-arc contribution is eventually at least −εn for every even n.

(let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ e:ℝ,0<e → ∃ N:ℕ,∀ n≥N, Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ))≤(I n (high n) (high n)).re) ↔ (
  let Q (n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2
  let K (n : ℕ) := n / (Nat.log 2 (n+2) + 1)^4
  let high (n p : ℕ) : ℝ := if p^3 ≤ n then 0 else if p.Prime then Real.log p else 0
  let mass (n k : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
    if ((p:ℤ) + r - n).natAbs = k then high n p * high n r else 0
  let ram (q k : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ d ∈ q.divisors,
    (if d ∣ k then (d:ℝ) else 0) * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q/d):ℝ)
  let length (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Q n),
    q.totient * (2*(Q n:ℝ) / ((q:ℝ)*n))
  let prefixSum (n t : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioc (K n) t,
    mass n k * ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Q n),
      ram q k * Real.sin (2*Real.pi*(k:ℝ)*((Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*n)))
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n →
    Real.pi⁻¹ * ((n:ℝ)⁻¹ * prefixSum n n + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ioo (K n) n,
      ((k:ℝ)⁻¹ - ((k+1:ℕ):ℝ)⁻¹) * prefixSum n k) ≤
    mass n 0 * (1-length n) + ε*n)

brief.en: Group ordered prime pairs by absolute offset. Use Ramanujan sums and the total prime-log mass to show that the removed band contributes o(n). Keep the diagonal and apply discrete summation by parts to the remaining offsets. Both sides quantify over all sufficiently large even targets.

title.en: Control exceptional sets and track what averages imply
